answer: Each new agent identity must lock a refundable stake before trading, and a fraud proof can slash it when several accounts coordinate to claim the same reward or issue conflicting attestations. Reputation and voting weight grow only from transactions that survive independent checks, so creating a Sybil swarm does not cheaply create influence. To attack, the adversary must fund and maintain many deposits, pay transaction fees, and risk losing them; this remains true whether the goods are basalt, vine, or juniper.
